title: RAW f83r whole-page pictured performer partition constrains the unchanged complete music reading
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. The already documented three single-figure panels and lower two-figure panel on f83r may supply an exhaustive 3+2 performer partition for the unchanged complete music family. Five explicit bridges would select an N=3 instance, not new words. All four owned f83r captions must also confront the literal91-value lexicon. Their strings were exposed during proposal development; the old71 contain none, and the added20 have not been checked. Repeated-person, panel-local and partial-picture rivals remain. No new pixels or semantic execution.

design.mechanism: A fixed whole-page figure-to-performer bijection supplies the participant-domain argument to three complete existing music paragraphs; it does not supply a new temporal law or vocabulary.
design.unit: All five documented f83r figure instances and the entire 150-position projected RAW485/487/491 music family, with every diplomatic gap retained.
design.contrast: Three distinct upper rota singers plus two lower pes performers versus repeated depictions of fewer persons, a nonexhaustive picture, or a thematic configuration unrelated to performer count.
design.prediction: Only the N=3 realization has an exhaustive partition under the new bridge. Its later-follower domain contains R2, while both pes retain independent parts/clocks. All six upper role permutations and both lower role permutations remain; the picture does not decide cue order, rhythm or temporal phase.
design.scope: Exposed GDT790 f83r only; no new label/prose body, new image or reserve.

actual_new_binding_input.fact: Three separate single-figure panels, respectively owning prose .1–8, .9–17 and .18–24. The source calls them a woman with spray/head, a woman in a round basin with loop/ring contact, and a woman with two downward streams. These are not observed singers.
One lower coupled double image with left woman, blue-green arch, right woman, lower channel and two open outlets; it owns complete P4 .25–30 and P5 .31–44 plus Q1 .47–49/Q2 .52–55.

actual_new_binding_input.fact: qotchedy permits FOUR rather than requiring exactly four; qolkain says THREE_OR_AT_LEAST_TWO; dal excludes pes from the rota count. The original semantic contract explicitly chooses N=2,3,4 with additional distinct U,L. Thus N=3 is literal old capacity, not a changed FOUR value.

complete_scope_and_stays_fixed.reading: All old clauses of full f83r P4/P5 and f76v.37–41 remain, with all91 denotations, grammar assumptions, four source-duration cases, separate performer/part/event types and both fixed final-negation variants. No family merger.
complete_scope_and_stays_fixed.image: Use all five figure instances; no favorable crop or selected subset. Four old label zones and the two embedded records remain unglossed here. They are not omitted from the physical picture or treated as confirmed music captions.
complete_scope_and_stays_fixed.literal_limits: The old projected95/150-group readings are not whole diplomatic translations: retain [?:s]cheol, so[r:s], salche'dy, saii@208;, the IT solchedy conflict, lolsaiiin and sar/sor conflict, and the absence of a complete alternate-reader parse.
complete_scope_and_stays_fixed.not_extension: This adds no adjacent paragraph and no new dictionary cap. It supplies a proposed visual participant set to already complete hypothetical content. It does not claim to read the three upper prose paragraphs or either embedded record.

new_assumptions_counted.assumption: The five visible figure instances represent five mutually distinct simultaneously available persons in one depicted performance, rather than repeated stages of one or more people.
The whole page is one exhaustive performer inventory for that particular realization. No unpictured performer and no decorative person is included in this model.
The three single-figure panels constitute the rota group; the lower coupled pair constitutes the accompaniment group. This is a functional role partition, not a conclusion from anatomical appearance.
The lower-panel P4/P5 instructions refer to the same whole-page realization. GDT790 grants panel ownership only, so crossing into upper panels is paid for explicitly.

Within each group no pictorial order is already known. Preserve all3! upper and2! lower assignments. Top-to-bottom must not silently choose leader/predecessor, and left/right must not silently choose upper/lower pes.

freedom.role_assignment_derivation: 3! times2!; no post-result preferred mapping. Figure individuation is the stronger prior assumption, not twelve independent observations.

two_distinct_follow_on_obligations.input: P4 initial onset clauses plus the image-supplied participant sets
two_distinct_follow_on_obligations.conditional_content: Exactly one of the three upper people and both lower people belong to the initial onset set; the other two upper people initially wait. Which upper person is leader is unresolved across the six assignments. The static drawing is not asserted to display this initial time.

two_distinct_follow_on_obligations.input: P5 predecessor rule and f76v NEXT_FOLLOWER domain
two_distinct_follow_on_obligations.conditional_content: Two successive upper-group follower entries exist, the second governed by the immediate predecessor rather than a repeated first-leader cue. R2 is nonvacuous, unlike N=2. The lower two performers continue their own clocks at that entry; visible coupling alone never licenses a reset.

strong_countercases_and_non_novel_output: GDT790 says PANEL_OWNER_ONLY, not person identity or performance ownership. Its lower P4/P5 panel itself contains only two figures. A strictly panel-local exhaustive performer inventory would contradict the four-person minimum; B4 explicitly chooses a different whole-page bridge rather than hiding that conflict.

Three separated single-figure panels may show one person at three procedural stages. Co-presence on one page does not establish physical distinctness. This is the strongest serious rival, not a malformed music program.
The figures have basins, streams and an arch; the reports identify no score, cue cross, singing gesture or musical instrument. The drawing can be thematic or show only some participants.

GDT1026 already found the positive conclusion contradictory for N=3/N=4 and vacuous for N=2. Selecting N=3 does not discover that contradiction again; the only proposed new information is the participant-domain binding.
All four source rhythm alternatives remain indistinguishable by these static images. No note duration, pitch, actual time or activity state can be recovered from a figure count.
GDT970 fixed whole-part literal code remains failed; IDEA521 embedded-note scope remains closed at its original lexical cap. Neither is repaired by this role map.

The exact local labels chtorol/olsaiin are FIGURE_OR_TUBE_ENDPOINT and PROXIMITY_AMBIGUOUS; sasoldal/darolsy are PROXIMITY_ONLY outlet labels. None currently identifies a singer, rest or temporal event.

smallest_decision_changing_followup.unknown: Whether any already owned, safely scoped description or whole existing content binds the five drawings as distinct coexisting participants of one account rather than sequential depictions. The present reports do not.
smallest_decision_changing_followup.step1: First perform the frozen complete four-caption literal91 membership and denotation/argument check, disclosing the earlier71 membership exposure. Then manually confront all12 figure-role maps with every old music clause. No event simulator is needed; if captions or person identity remain unbound, stop at the explicit gap.
smallest_decision_changing_followup.decision: A separately justified distinct/exhaustive whole-page bridge would narrow the music realization to N=3. A bound repeated-person or partial-illustration account defeats that bridge without refuting music. If the identity and whole-page bridge remain unbound, retain RAW with zero independent confirmation and do not rerun the old twelve performances.
smallest_decision_changing_followup.no_automatic_next_step: Do not seek new pictures, extract new labels, repair the embedded paragraphs or count conditional N=3 consistency as semantic confirmation.

all_owned_f83r_caption_obligation.scope: Exactly every GDT790 graphical label locus on page=f83r: .45,.46,.50,.51, the four whole one-group labels. Keep all four even if none receives a value. This is not the two embedded prose records Q1/Q2, whose IDEA521 cap failure remains unchanged.

Membership was also inspected against the old71 music meanings and all four were absent. No inspection of the added20/91 membership has been performed. This is an exposed, exploratory nomination, not a blind/prospective-label-content experiment.
all_owned_f83r_caption_obligation.next_frozen_question: Before using this as a whole image/text interpretation, compare all four literal whole labels with all91 unchanged music denotations. Where present, preserve the whole denotation and its argument types, then explicitly account for its use at that pictured location in each of the12 role maps. Where absent, report UNKNOWN_UNDER_FIXED91 without invented captions or substring inheritance.
all_owned_f83r_caption_obligation.what_counts_as_binding: A caption may name, predicate, refer, or use a written/deictic context. It need not be a noun. But its particular missing arguments and antecedents must be named explicitly from the retained whole content; an arbitrary hidden proposition per caption is not supplied for free. No role label is selected merely because it is next to a woman.
all_owned_f83r_caption_obligation.decision_boundary: A complete fixed91 crossmodal account requires a denotation and scoped use for all four. Unknown words or unbound arguments stop that completion; they do not refute the old music paragraphs. Incompatible fixed meanings reject only the specified combined image/caption bridge. Merely preserving the 3+2 count without caption binding remains this incomplete RAW.
all_owned_f83r_caption_obligation.strong_primary_limit: GDT1032 documents actual historical similiter hic inscriptions and defeats noun-only caption rules. It does not license arbitrary omitted arguments, and does not identify a Voynich caption.
all_owned_f83r_caption_obligation.not_yet_done: No91-membership lookup or semantic caption evaluation; no new label collection.
